t: Beyond RAG: Integrating Python MCP Servers with a Local LLM
s: This article outlines a vision for Pipulate to use a local LLM as an MCP client, enabling it to access external services via the Model Context Protocol. This approach enhances agentic capabilities, promotes modularity, and fosters digital sovereignty by moving away from API key dependencies.
sub: Local LLM as MCP Client Architecture
Digital Sovereignty & End of API Key Dependency
